name: Sev Puri
subtitle: flat crisp puris loaded with potato, chutneys and a mound of fine sev
prepNotes: Sev puri uses the flat papdi, not the hollow shell. Pricking the discs before frying is what keeps them flat.
The sev should be fine, not thick. Thick sev turns the dish chewy.

steps.text: Make a stiff maida dough with 2 tbsp oil and cold water. Rest 20 minutes.
Roll thin, cut 5cm discs, prick all over, and fry at 160C until hard and barely coloured.
Blend mint, coriander, chilli and lemon into a thick green chutney.
Fry fine sev from a stiff besan batter, or use bought.
Lay the puris out, top each with potato and onion.
Spoon on tamarind chutney and green chutney, dust with chaat masala, black salt and chilli powder.
Bury the lot in sev and serve at once.
steps.tip: Sev last, and generously. It is the name of the dish.

storage: Puris and sev keep two weeks airtight. Assembled, they last about a minute.
